classrooms_period_months_ck.name: classrooms_period_months_ck
classrooms_period_months_ck.value: ("classrooms"."period_start" is null and "classrooms"."period_end" is null) or ("classrooms"."period_start" is not null and "classrooms"."period_end" is not null and "classrooms"."period_start" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' and "classrooms"."period_end" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' and "classrooms"."period_end" >= "classrooms"."period_start")

evaluations_owned_poll_idx.name: evaluations_owned_poll_idx
evaluations_owned_poll_idx.where: ("evaluations"."classroom_id" is null and "evaluations"."course_id" is null and "evaluations"."mode" = 'poll')

evaluations_home_ck.name: evaluations_home_ck
evaluations_home_ck.value: ("evaluations"."classroom_id" is not null and "evaluations"."course_id" is null) or ("evaluations"."classroom_id" is null and "evaluations"."course_id" is not null) or ("evaluations"."classroom_id" is null and "evaluations"."course_id" is null and "evaluations"."mode" = 'poll' and "evaluations"."created_by" is not null)

evaluations_template_ck.name: evaluations_template_ck
evaluations_template_ck.value: "evaluations"."course_id" is null or ("evaluations"."opens_at" is null and "evaluations"."closes_at" is null and "evaluations"."access_code" is null and cardinality("evaluations"."ip_allowlist") = 0 and "evaluations"."state" = 'draft' and "evaluations"."mode" <> 'poll' and "evaluations"."revision" is not null and "evaluations"."origin_template_id" is null)

drill_cards_serve_ck.name: drill_cards_serve_ck
drill_cards_serve_ck.value: "drill_cards"."serve_seed" is not null or ("drill_cards"."shown_since" is null and "drill_cards"."active_ms" = 0)

drill_cards_serve_values_ck.name: drill_cards_serve_values_ck
drill_cards_serve_values_ck.value: "drill_cards"."serve_seed" is not null or "drill_cards"."serve_values" is null

classroom_journals_mode_ck.name: classroom_journals_mode_ck
classroom_journals_mode_ck.value:
("classroom_journals"."mode" = 'github' AND "classroom_journals"."github_repo_id" IS NOT NULL AND "classroom_journals"."full_name" IS NOT NULL AND "classroom_journals"."ref" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("classroom_journals"."mode" = 'quiz' AND "classroom_journals"."github_repo_id" IS NULL AND "classroom_journals"."full_name" IS NULL AND "classroom_journals"."ref" IS NULL)

gradebook_marks_shape.name: gradebook_marks_shape
gradebook_marks_shape.value:
("gradebook_marks"."kind" = 'absent' AND "gradebook_marks"."points" IS NULL AND "gradebook_marks"."max" IS NULL)
        OR ("gradebook_marks"."kind" = 'score' AND "gradebook_marks"."points" IS NOT NULL AND "gradebook_marks"."max" IS NOT NULL AND "gradebook_marks"."max" > 0 AND "gradebook_marks"."points" >= 0 AND "gradebook_marks"."points" <= "gradebook_marks"."max")

project_repos_freeze_due_idx.name: project_repos_freeze_due_idx
project_repos_freeze_due_idx.where: "project_repos"."deadline_applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_repos"."frozen_at" IS NULL

concept_tag_sortings_decided_ck.name: concept_tag_sortings_decided_ck
concept_tag_sortings_decided_ck.value:
("concept_tag_sortings"."decision" is null) = ("concept_tag_sortings"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("concept_tag_sortings"."decision" is not null or ("concept_tag_sortings"."proposal" is not null and "concept_tag_sortings"."decided_by" is null))

concept_tag_sortings_decision_ck.name: concept_tag_sortings_decision_ck
concept_tag_sortings_decision_ck.value:
("concept_tag_sortings"."concept_id" is not null) = ("concept_tag_sortings"."decision" is not distinct from 'concept')
        and ("concept_tag_sortings"."drop_reason" is not null) = ("concept_tag_sortings"."decision" is not distinct from 'drop')

concepts_merged_ck.name: concepts_merged_ck
concepts_merged_ck.value: ("concepts"."status" = 'merged') = ("concepts"."merged_into" is not null) and "concepts"."merged_into" is distinct from "concepts"."id"

concepts_label_ck.name: concepts_label_ck
concepts_label_ck.value: "concepts"."label_fr" is not null or "concepts"."label_en" is not null
